description: P2 audit correction. People owns swap_channel_weights: inspect callers/cross-owner semantics, lock Person(s) before channels in stable ID order, reread current rows and never use stale struct weights. Tests first: stale BO B/C after B/A/C reorder yields C/A/B, deterministic transaction-held reorder-vs-swap and swap-vs-stale-draft, invalid/missing/owner-change cases and existing swap contracts. Real DB, no sleeps/mocks. Update people-access, UX/handoff; rerun full previously scoped 260 cases plus regression, mix format/q/diff check. Working-tree only. Graph: correction -> reopened validation .7 -> final human approval .3 -> E2E .4.

comments.text: Call-site audit: only Engine PeopleGateway and BO adjacent-channel moves call swap. No tests restrict cross-owner swaps; preserve existing trusted cross-owner behavior by locking all supplied literal Person owners ascending, then channels ascending. Reread and verify each channel still belongs to its supplied owner; deleted/transferred/invalid coordinates return not_found, no alias following. Preserve successful return shape and update_channel activity semantics. Tests reproduce stale weights and both deterministic serialized interleavings.
